applied_addition_basis: Manual identity review of source-backed artist credits from episodes with exact BBC embedded-tracklist / RadioFiles position-by-position full-list matches. Each addition has a BBC episode URL, RadioFiles URL, track example and written rationale in the review CSV.

held_for_identity_review.reason: High name similarity and conflicting title-credit metadata; do not add or alias until resolved.

backup_policy: The 833-row backup is intentionally retained as the pre-manual-review pool. Do not overwrite or delete it. The dated reviewed snapshot must remain byte-identical to the authoritative pool at the time of this audit.
pool_mutation_policy: This is an explicit manually reviewed update, not automatic updater mutation. Future automated updater runs must remain review-only.
